text: You blame us for years, been locked in containers Mucks on the street, keep stealing street papers You ain't shit, spitting out rhymes out my anus My aim is to target you punks from all angles Minus two majors, making small changes Hoping this UK seat, it all changes Me, I keep a grip on life like fucks with my status You gotta be ahead by at least three places Those that are not, they shall remain nameless
